0022600162.text: Washington stands at 2-3 with a 1-2 road record and a two-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Southeast, one game back, and 9th in the East. Orlando is 1-3 with a 0-2 home record and a one-game losing streak, sitting 4th in the Southeast and 11th in the East, and the Magic are missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The Wizards are also without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though Washington lost 1-3 to Orlando in 2025-26, including a 136-131 defeat in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
